25.9.0 - Fusaka Testnet Release Important This is an optional update for Mainnet users. This is a required update for Holesky, Sepolia and Hoodi users for the upcoming Fusaka hardfork. There is likely to be another release before Hoodi and maybe before Sepolia. Fusaka Hardfork details: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7607#activation Holešky scheduled to fork on 2025-10-01 08:48:00 Sepolia scheduled to fork on 2025-10-14 07:36:00 Hoodi scheduled to fork on 2025-10-28 18:53:12 Known issues Affects users of eth_subscribe (WebSocket) eg SSV, and ethstats integration symptom: io.vertx.core.json.EncodeException: Failed to encode as JSON: Java 8 optional type fixes and more info: #9212 and #9220 if you experience this issue, you can downgrade to the previous released version of Besu, or build off main if that is an option for your environment. fixes will be included in the next Besu release. Breaking Changes Remove deprecated option --bonsai-maximum-back-layers-to-load (deprecated since 23.4.0).
